title: A PEM private key with body lines under 40 characters reached the Jev request apart from its header
resolution: redactedExcerpt now replaces the whole PEM block, through its end line or to the end of the text, before the other patterns and the clip; tests cover short lines, 64-character lines, and a block without an end line.

title: The false criterion of the third pass question omitted a clean pass 2 and a review ending after a Low-only pass
resolution: The false criterion now names a review ending after a Low-only pass and a pass 2 without Critical or High findings whose fixes touch only records and documentation; design.md and the test follow.

title: The true criterion of the third pass question overlapped the widened false criterion for a Low-only pass 2 whose fixes touch code
resolution: The true criterion now names a Critical or High finding, or a Medium finding whose fixes change code, tests, or contracts; the test, design.md D1, and verification.md follow.

title: A PGP private key block was not redacted whole, so its short last body line and checksum line could reach the request
resolution: PEM_BLOCK also matches a PRIVATE KEY BLOCK header; a new test covers a PGP block with a short last line and a checksum line.

title: The route command built the shadow input before the credential check, so an unreadable archive refused the whole command
resolution: The shadow router gets a function that builds its input, called after the credential check; a build failure is the new failure code input-unavailable, the command exits 0; schema, spec delta, and protocol follow; new tests.

title: The request content requirement dropped change names and source text from the earlier guarantee of what is never sent
resolution: The requirement now excludes change names and source text too, and stays under 500 characters; an archive in a scratch copy gives strictly valid specs.

title: verification.md said that the generated checks recorded the make verify run of 23d30381, which they did not
resolution: The sentence no longer claims the generated part for 23d30381, and the run on the tree of 681566b7 after the pass 1 fixes is recorded.

title: The fail-before evidence did not show that the three PEM redaction tests fail against the code before the pass 1 fix
resolution: The three PEM tests were run against the scripts of aaabdd96 and failed 3 of 3; verification.md records the result and its log.

title: The effect figures kept the name brierScore for a score that now covers only answers to the earlier tier question
resolution: The legacy scores move into a tierRequest group with its own change count, beside thirdPass; tests and the printed line use it.

title: The narrowed true criterion required the code fix to belong to the Medium finding, so a pass 2 whose Medium was fixed in documentation and whose Low was fixed in code met neither criterion
resolution: By the coordinator's decision the true criterion now covers a pass 2 with a Medium finding whose fixes, those of accompanying Low findings included, change files other than records and documentation; the test, design.md D1, and verification.md follow. The pass cap allows no fourth pass.
